doc.summary: Flow graph model and deterministic layered layout (Sugiyama style).
doc.description:
Every architecture and execution-flow diagram is first built as a
FlowGraph (nodes with a title, wrapped detail lines, shape, tone and a
detail payload; typed edges). layout_flow() then places it:

1. Ranks: explicit ranks when the builder provides them (architecture
   tiers), otherwise longest-path ranks over the DAG left after removing
   DFS back edges.
2. Order: barycentric up/down sweeps reduce crossings.
3. Wrapping: a rank wider than ``max_per_row`` is folded into several
   rows, so no diagram degenerates into a thin strip.
4. Coordinates: every row is placed under the barycenter of its parents,
   overlaps are pushed apart, rows are stacked by their real heights.
5. Routing: forward edges are vertical cubic curves; back edges (loops,
   recursion, upward dependencies) leave on the right and bend around.

Sizes come from monospace text metrics, so the same coordinates drive
the SVG viewer and the PIL video frames. Pure Python, deterministic.

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: Free payload for the viewer side panel (file, line, doc, href, ...).

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Cubic Bezier control points after layout (start, c1, c2, end).

attributes.name: lanes
attributes.description: Horizontal bands as dicts (title, y, h) after layout.

doc.summary: Serialise the laid-out diagram for the HTML viewer.
Text and spacing metrics shared by the layout, the SVG viewer, and the video.

attributes.name: char_w
attributes.description: Width of one monospace character of detail text.

attributes.name: max_chars
attributes.description: Wrap width of detail lines in characters.

attributes.name: gap_x
attributes.description: Gap between nodes in a row.

attributes.name: max_per_row
attributes.description: Rank width before wrapping into another row.

doc.summary: Set the node's wrapped lines and its width and height from text metrics.

name: layout_flow
signature: def layout_flow(graph: FlowGraph, metrics: Optional[LayoutMetrics] = None, direction: str = 'TB') -> FlowGraph

doc.summary: Lay out *graph* in place and return it.

params.name: direction
params.description: TB (ranks top to bottom) or LR (ranks left to right).

returns.description: The same graph with node coordinates, edge control points, lanes, and size.

name: layout_sequence

doc.summary: Place sequence participants as columns and messages as rows.

params.name: graph

returns.description: The graph with participant x / box width and message y filled in.
